basis.M1: v1/v1.2 exact-scene identity, Procrustes and affine-ridge retrieval compatibility gates failed on the sealed Jeju cohort
basis.M85: task-adjacent version comparison only; not a downstream cache migration experiment
basis.MS98_MS99: Solar Farm supplies a full 12-band downstream task and sealed geographic folds

question: Can unlabeled exact-scene paired spatial embeddings from OlmoEarth v1 and v1.2 preserve an old v1 downstream head and index after the encoder release changes, without rereading and re-encoding the historical raw archive? New query imagery is still read normally by the v1.2 encoder.
primary_scenario: query-side backward compatibility: keep the old v1 cache, index and v1-trained head; map new v1.2 embeddings into the v1 contract
primary_task: Task-2 Solar Farm because its OlmoEarth view has all 12 Sentinel-2 bands required symmetrically by v1 and v1.2

split.unit: existing sealed Task-2 held-out UTM-zone fold group
split.bridge_fit: paired v1/v1.2 embeddings from source-train windows only; no segmentation labels
split.final_evaluation: held-out target fold labels used only after bridge and threshold are frozen

arms.R0_old_reference: old v1 head on old v1 embeddings
arms.R1_identity: old v1 head directly on v1.2 embeddings
arms.R4_affine_ridge: source-only paired affine ridge; M1 strongest simple bridge
arms.R5_spatial_stitch: source-only paired 3x3 depthwise plus 1x1 residual bridge, trained only if the two-fold simple-bridge screen fails; architecture and loss must be committed before its first run
arms.R6_new_native_ceiling: new v1.2 head trained on v1.2 source embeddings under the same decoder recipe
arms.R7_full_reembed_cost_reference: new v1.2 cache plus new head; accuracy and total backfill cost reference

primary: positive-tile macro IoU at a threshold selected on source validation and then frozen
secondary: empty-tile false positives at the frozen threshold

screen.scope: two exposed Task-2 folds, three seeds
screen.pass: R4 retains at least 90% of R0 AP in both folds and improves over R1 by at least 0.05 AP in both folds
screen.fail: if R4 fails, run only the precommitted R5 spatial-stitch screen; if R5 also fails, report that exact-scene linear/spatial bridging is insufficient and stop before eight-fold expansion

confirmatory_gate.compatibility: best preselected bridge is within 0.02 AP absolute and within 5% relative primary IoU of R0 in at least 6/8 folds
confirmatory_gate.better_than_naive: bridge beats R1 by at least 0.01 AP in at least 6/8 folds
confirmatory_gate.cost: incremental bridge plus migration cost consumes at most 10% of the historical full-archive reread and v1.2 re-embedding cost; normal raw input for each new v1.2 query is counted and is not claimed to be zero

controls: source-validation threshold frozen before target evaluation
forbidden_claims: universal backward compatibility from one release pair or one task
